data.name: Usage
data.value:
Usage: ComCon [options] ComCon --list PORT Port to connect to (e.g. COM3, com3, 3) Options: -b, --baud Baud rate (default: 115200) -d, --data <5-8> Data bits (default: 8) -p, --parity

none | odd | even | mark | space (default: none) -s, --stop 1 | 1.5 | 2 (default: 1) -f, --flow none | rtscts | xonxoff | both (default: none) -n, --newline Newline sent for Enter: cr | lf | crlf (default: cr) -e, --echo Enable local echo --encoding Text encoding for both directions (default: utf-8, e.g. shift_jis) --no-dtr Do not turn DTR on --no-rts Do not turn RTS on --lang Message language: en | ja (default: OS language) -l, --list List available ports -h, --help Show this help While connected, press Ctrl+] followed by: q Quit b Send a break signal e Toggle local echo Ctrl+] Send Ctrl+] itself ? Show help
